title: Carrier Wave
style: industrial post-punk, driving bassline, distorted guitars, cold synth stabs, urgent male vocal, motorik drums, 132 bpm, dystopian, cinematic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I was born inside a copper line
Grew up listening to a humming sky
Every word my mother ever said
Still bouncing through the static overhead

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't tell me silence is a free man's choice
The quiet costs more than my voice

[Chorus]
I am the carrier, I am the wave
I am the message no one saved
Ride me down the wire, ride me through the night
I am the carrier, hold on tight

[Verse 2]
City made of antennas in the rain
Every rooftop praying for a name
Every window flickering a code
Every body humming down the road

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't tell me silence is a free man's choice
The quiet costs more than my voice

[Chorus]
I am the carrier, I am the wave
I am the message no one saved
Ride me down the wire, ride me through the night
I am the carrier, hold on tight

[Bridge]
The transmitter, the transmitter, the transmitter never sleeps
The transmitter, the transmitter, the transmitter keeps

[Outro]
Hold on tight
Hold on tight
Hold on tight
Through the night
